g1-implement.title: G1 per-class sigma-plus law (pure numeric core): implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer. TASK: make the one-sided grip sigma-plus a PER-CLASS quantity in the pure numeric core. (a) src/physics/utilization/class_ledger.py — add ONE additive field to ClassDeficits: time_by_class_s, the real lap's per-class transit time, which class_deficits already computes as W.T @ dt_real_seg and currently discards. No other behaviour change; the field is additive and defaults are not needed because the dataclass is constructed in one place. (b) src/physics/utilization/class_utilization_observable.py — add a pure function per_class_sigma_plus(sigma_lap, time_share_by_class) -> np.ndarray implementing the LINEAR common-mode law sigma_plus_c = w_c * sigma_lap (ruling D2: the grip sigma is ONE session-level scalar, so its per-class contributions are perfectly correlated and SUM to the lap value; quadrature would encode a false independence claim and must not be used). Derive w_c inside compute_class_utilization_observable from deficits.time_by_class_s (ruling D3: the DRIVER'S REAL lap, and by construction the same dt_real_seg integral the deficit came from). Give each OneSidedGripBand its own scale, and add a sigma_plus_by_class array field to ClassUtilizationObservable. KEEP the existing scalar g_sigma_onesided field as the LAP-LEVEL scale with unchanged meaning (critic finding F3 — the lap value must stay recoverable). Write the rationale into the module docstring's binding pre-ruling section: what the whole-lap-sigma-into-a-per-class-band mismatch was, why time share is the unit-coherent bridge, why linear and not quadrature, and that per_class_sigma_plus is the single documented swap point for #712's consumer-contract decision. (c) tests/unit/physics/test_class_utilization_observable.py — the WIDTH-SHAPE test set the issue's acceptance names: monotone in time share; sum over classes equals the lap sigma exactly; every per-class width <= the lap sigma; a single populated class recovers the lap sigma; sigma_lap = 0 gives all-zero widths; grip=None unchanged; AND (critic finding F2) an explicit case pinning that the width is INDEPENDENT of deficit magnitude — a large deficit in a thin-time-share class does NOT widen its band. Also assert the point deficits (speed_deficit_by_class, time_deficit_by_class, lap_time_deficit_s) are byte-identical with and without the grip wrap.

g3-implement.title: G3 band-distribution reporter (W2's scored artifact): implement
g3-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer. FIRST, a plan-authored precondition: search src/, scripts/ and tests/ for an existing band-distribution reporter. At planning time none existed and every sibling W2 issue (#679/#678/#687/#686/#688) was still open, so this gate mints it — but if one has since landed, EXTEND it and report the divergence rather than minting a second (one canonical path). TASK: create scripts/report_grip_band_distribution.py — a read-only reporter over a reference-utilization store that emits W2's separately scored artifact per the confirmed spec's T7/IF15/T19/T20 amendments: median, p90, vacuous count (band > 10 s, the threshold #721's own measurement used), and plausible-|D| count (band <= the 0.1-0.2 s deficit scale) over the per-class widths; PLUS the retained-session fraction and a substrate-provenance block naming the store path, its session/row counts and its format_version (critic finding F5). It must ALSO be able to report the analytic re-scale of a format_version=1 store — reading driver_class_observables together with reference_laps.time_shares_json and applying w_c * sigma_lap — so the same tool gives a before/after on a store built by the old code and can be re-run at every later W2 chain step (T19 per-step deltas). It opens SQLite read-only (mode=ro) and NEVER writes to an input store. On an ABSENT or unreadable store it HARD-FAILS with a non-zero exit and a message naming the missing path — it must never skip, never soft-degrade to an empty report, and never emit numbers that read as evidence when none were computed (T7: 'harnesses pass' carries zero evidence otherwise). Author tests/unit/physics/test_grip_band_distribution_report.py: synthetic-store fixtures for each statistic, a per-class breakdown assertion, and an explicit test that an absent store HARD-FAILS rather than skipping.
